1.title: Anthropic Says It Blocked Possible Efforts to Build Biological Weapons
1.summary: In a new report, the A.I. start-up added that it could not determine if the research was legitimate or nefarious, leading the company to shut down the work.

2.title: Supreme Court Again Blocks Republican-Backed Missouri Voting Map
2.summary: The ruling deferred to the state’s Supreme Court, which had invalidated G.O.P.-friendly district lines, saying voters must first have an opportunity to approve the map in a statewide referendum.

3.title: Princess Diana’s ‘Revenge Dress’ to Be Sold at Auction in New York
3.summary: Diana, Princess of Wales, wore the cocktail dress in 1994 at a moment of intense public scrutiny. An auction house expected it to fetch up to $300,000.

4.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
4.summary: One pilot told the other about the aircraft's "excessive speed" but received an uneven response even as alarms sounded.

5.title: More than 20 children feared dead in DR Congo school fire
5.summary: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

6.title: Houthis Seize Strategic Red Sea Port, a Major Victory for Iranian Ally
6.summary: The Iran-backed militia routed Yemeni government forces in Mokha, putting the group in a stronger position to attack ships in a crucial waterway for global trade.
